categories.scope: Board mounting data transcribed from the official Arduino datasheet drawings (docs.arduino.cc). Uno overall outline is not dimensioned in the official datasheet and is intentionally absent.
Selected common metric 6xx, 6000 and 6200 series. No suffix substitution or fit allowance is implied.
Bare cell envelope limits from the manufacturer datasheet for the named cell only. Other 18650 cells differ; do not generalize. Excludes protection circuits, tabs and wrappers.
Vendor-specific holes; actual insert length, material and polymer must be chosen before use.
Exact published motor models in NEMA 14/17/23 families. Not a claim that all motors in a family have identical hole type or depth.

Phone body height, width and depth as printed on the manufacturer tech specs pages. Both manufacturers state that size varies by configuration and manufacturing process. No case, camera bump or tolerance is implied. A case, holder or dock needs a pocket at least the phone's depth deep, plus clearance.
Published PCB envelopes and explicitly dimensioned port centerlines. Not complete enclosure manufacturing data.
Metric coarse cutting tap and clearance sizes. Close/normal/loose are separate fit choices; no printer compensation included.
Published Polymaker spool variants; capacity is not a universal dimensional standard. Check the actual supplied revision.

Standard external full-depth spur gears with zero profile shift and no backlash adjustment. m in mm, z tooth count, alpha an angle interpreted consistently by cos. Does not generate involute flanks, root fillets or certify undercut limits.
